gen.title: Why delegates created a new plan for government

cards.stem: How does the page describe the constitution as a result of many people working together?
options: a model of cooperative statesmanship and the art of compromise
a failed plan forced by a single leader
a temporary deal to end a war quickly
cards.quote: The work of many minds, the Constitution stands as a model of cooperative statesmanship and the art of compromise
cards.hint: Look for how the page praises teamwork at the end

cards.stem: What did delegates have to wait for before they could start their work?
options: a quorum of seven states
a letter from the central government
a vote by the people directly
cards.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25
cards.hint: Think about the number of states needed to start

cards.stem: What did the convention decide to do instead of just changing the old articles?
options: an entirely new frame of government
a minor edit to the state house rules
an immediate election by state legislators
cards.quote: rather than amend the existing Articles, the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government
cards.hint: Recall the choice between amending and starting fresh

cards.stem: How was the drafting of the constitution carried out during that summer?
options: Drafted in secret
Approved by a public vote
Written in open public sessions
cards.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787
cards.hint: Consider where and how delegates met that summer
